implementation:
let rec go (pred : Nat → Bool) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: tail => if pred x then x :: go pred tail else go pred tail
go p xs
proof:
by
  unfold Spec
  intro p xs
  simp only [candidate]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases hp : p x <;> simp [candidate.go, hp, ih]
